events_ends_after_start.name: events_ends_after_start
events_ends_after_start.value: "events"."ends_at" IS NULL OR ("events"."starts_at" IS NOT NULL AND "events"."ends_at" > "events"."starts_at")

events_time_range.name: events_time_range
events_time_range.value:
("events"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "events"."starts_at" BETWEEN '2000-01-01T00:00+09:00' AND '2999-12-31T23:59+09:00')
    AND ("events"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "events"."ends_at" BETWEEN '2000-01-01T00:00+09:00' AND '2999-12-31T23:59+09:00')

expenses_void_triple.name: expenses_void_triple
expenses_void_triple.value: ("expenses"."voided_at" IS NULL) = ("expenses"."voided_by" IS NULL) AND ("expenses"."voided_at" IS NULL) = ("expenses"."void_reason" IS NULL)

incomes_event_active_unique.name: incomes_event_active_unique
incomes_event_active_unique.where: "incomes"."event_id" IS NOT NULL AND "incomes"."voided_at" IS NULL

incomes_carried_from_active_unique.name: incomes_carried_from_active_unique
incomes_carried_from_active_unique.where: "incomes"."carried_from_period_id" IS NOT NULL AND "incomes"."voided_at" IS NULL

incomes_void_triple.name: incomes_void_triple
incomes_void_triple.value: ("incomes"."voided_at" IS NULL) = ("incomes"."voided_by" IS NULL) AND ("incomes"."voided_at" IS NULL) = ("incomes"."void_reason" IS NULL)

purchase_items_receipt_purchased.name: purchase_items_receipt_purchased
purchase_items_receipt_purchased.value: "purchase_items"."received_at" IS NULL OR "purchase_items"."purchased_at" IS NOT NULL

registration_forms_time_range.name: registration_forms_time_range
registration_forms_time_range.value:
("registration_forms"."opens_at" IS NULL OR "registration_forms"."opens_at" BETWEEN '2000-01-01T00:00+09:00' AND '2999-12-31T23:59+09:00')
    AND "registration_forms"."closes_at" BETWEEN '2000-01-01T00:00+09:00' AND '2999-12-31T23:59+09:00'

registrations_purged_state.name: registrations_purged_state
registrations_purged_state.value:
("registrations"."purged_at" IS NULL AND "registrations"."token_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "registrations"."name" IS NOT NULL
    AND "registrations"."student_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("registrations"."purged_at" IS NOT NULL AND "registrations"."token_hash" IS NULL AND "registrations"."name" IS NULL
    AND "registrations"."student_id" IS NULL AND "registrations"."phone" IS NULL)

registrations_cancel_purges.name: registrations_cancel_purges
registrations_cancel_purges.value: "registrations"."cancelled_at" IS NULL OR "registrations"."purged_at" IS NOT NULL

registrations_cancelled_pair.name: registrations_cancelled_pair
registrations_cancelled_pair.value: "registrations"."cancelled_by" IS NULL OR "registrations"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL

registrations_paid_triple.name: registrations_paid_triple
registrations_paid_triple.value: ("registrations"."paid_at" IS NULL) = ("registrations"."paid_amount" IS NULL) AND ("registrations"."paid_at" IS NULL) = ("registrations"."paid_by" IS NULL)
